transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: assistant.message with a non-empty string content emits conversation:assistant-message final true. Empty content emits nothing. messageId falls back to the log entry id.

applicability.notes: conversation is undeclared. final is always true on this helper. No reply.at is set. The log timestamp stays on the normalized record, not inside the event. It is newer than shipped Vibefield 0.3.3 and does not describe that install. Package comparison was not re-run. Declaration unknown from no capability cell.  Declared support does not match the producer channel. Unsupported or degraded does not make a later runtime combination impossible.
